one_minute_value_explanation: AOF can now turn raw provider observations into an operator-readable replay that explains what external state was read, why it mattered, what changed, and what remains unproven.
thirty_second_version_delta: v11.4 made agent sessions and tool governance auditable; v11.5 makes provider-read evidence understandable without raw JSON reconstruction.
product_review_trigger: If an operator still cannot explain what provider state was read and what remains unproven in 30 seconds, reopen provider replay UX and record structure.
not_proven: This does not prove provider semantic truth, credential safety, GitHub write safety, production automation, market value, productivity gain, or broad adoption.
